name: Motorcycle Simulator South Dakota
summary:
Ride Sioux Falls, South Dakota, from the seat - alone or with your friends.

37 KM ROUND SIOUX FALLS
Start on the East Side and head south on I-229, over the Big Sioux River and west across the south side past Cliff Avenue and Minnesota Avenue. Swing onto I-29 and open it up on the long, dead-straight run north past the Empire and the airport, then east on I-90 along the prairie edge of the city - with the Premier Center, the Cathedral of Saint Joseph and the Arc of Dreams on the skyline.

RIDE IT LIKE A RE
